UW Health is the integrated health system affiliated with the University of Wisconsin–Madison and the University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health. We provide exceptional care through hospitals, clinics and specialty programs across Wisconsin, northern Illinois and beyond.

As Wisconsin's No. 1 hospital, we combine expert patient care, leading-edge research, education and innovation to advance health without compromise. Our physicians, nurses, researchers and care teams are dedicated to improving lives through breakthrough discoveries and compassionate care.

On this channel, you'll find patient stories, health and wellness information, expert insights, medical innovations and a behind-the-scenes look at the people who make remarkable health care possible.

UW Health is proud to be the Official Health Care Partner of the Green Bay Packers.
